[b01; pagina=N/A; tipo=heading]
A portable laboratory

[b02; pagina=N/A; tipo=paragraph]
The imaginary laboratory records three samples without using personal records. Each sample has a readable description and a value in its original written form. The identifier 0012 names a series, while −7 records a signed change. The decimal point in 123.45 remains part of the observation. A revision can correct a transcription only while retaining the original document and a reason for the change.

[b03; pagina=N/A; tipo=formula]


E=mc^{2}

[b04; pagina=N/A; tipo=table]


Code | Value | Note

0012 | 0 | 

B | −7 | 123.45

Measured cells

[b06; pagina=N/A; tipo=paragraph]
The observation carries a note and a route to the next chapter.

note_call: note → chapter2.xhtml#n1

[b07; pagina=N/A; tipo=heading]
Results across chapters

[b08; pagina=N/A; tipo=paragraph]
The second observation separates content from its position on the page. A sentence can occupy two lines without changing its words, but a missing line changes the result. Empty cells are present in the table and do not ask the reader to invent a measurement. The figure contains colored regions, axes and a legend. A matching filename cannot establish that those elements survived conversion. The value exclusive to the second chapter is 84.20.

[b09; pagina=N/A; tipo=formula]


\frac{x_i+1}{2}
